sourceDescriptions: This situation happens in forests if a lightning strikes.

sourceDescriptions: A heavy splash caught in slow motion.

sourceDescriptions: Before credit card advent, money and coins were the real deal to trade or buy goods.

sourceDescriptions: This huge bird may look like an ostrich but it has more in common with a deadly velociraptor.

Heavy walls protect lords' dungeons against marching armies.

GiCastleRuins.label: Castle ruins
sourceDescriptions: This castle used to be a symbol of power for its lord. Now it's only the reflect of its downfall.

GiCat.label: Cat
sourceDescriptions: A little tamed feline that can easily hunt in the snow without being noticed by mice.

GiCatapult.label: Catapult
sourceDescriptions: Medieval war machine throwing heavy rocks or dead bodies to destroy fortresses walls.

GiCaterpillar.label: Caterpillar

sourceDescriptions: It has a place of choice in Panoramix kitchen to mix the famous magic potion.
To boil weird liquid preparations, like mana soup or melted frog juice with cinnamon.

GiCavalry.label: Cavalry
sourceDescriptions: A mounted knight leading his horse to victory. It's quite devastating against infantry.

GiCaveEntrance.label: Cave entrance

GiCaveman.label: Caveman

GiCellarBarrels.label: Cellar barrels
sourceDescriptions: Wine or whisky being kept in the coolness of an underground winery.

sourceDescriptions: To stay immobile because of heavy weight at your feet. This strategy is also employed by the mafia to hide bodies at the bottom of lake and rivers.

GiCentaurHeart.label: Centaur heart

GiCentipede.label: Centipede

GiCenturionHelmet.label: Centurion helmet
sourceDescriptions: A galea with a crimson crest to impress during an encounter.

GiCeremonialMask.label: Ceremonial mask

GiChainedArrowHeads.label: Chained arrow heads
sourceDescriptions: Tips of arrows following each other along a line.

GiChaingun.label: Chaingun
sourceDescriptions: 6 rotating chambers ready to fire at high speed.

GiChainLightning.label: Chain lightning
sourceDescriptions: Domino effects dealing damages on troups.

GiChainMail.label: Chain mail
sourceDescriptions: Metal T-Shirt to block blade stabbing.

GiChainsaw.label: Chainsaw

sourceDescriptions: It's apero time, with ham, bacon, paté, rillettes, saucisson, cheese…
